https://www.ncl.ac.uk/tuition-fees/funding/ confirms 2% off annual fees for international fee-paying students (and home-fee postgraduates) paying in full on or before 25 September 2026; excludes students fully paid by a tuition fee loan; part-sponsored students get it only on their own share.

The page does not state levels, so 'undergraduate, postgraduate' and requires_offer are inferred. The 2026 date has passed (today is 2026-10-13) and the page does not confirm the discount for 2027/28. It is a payment discount, not a competitive scholarship.
